text: Sergeant Newell K. Schneider was out on patrol in the early morning hours of March 17th.
He was riding with Deputy David Fitzpatrick.
They were among the first to observe the phenomena which has been seen in the Ann Arbor area around this county several times.
Sergeant Schneider, can you tell us what you saw and how you happened to see it?
Well, it was somewhat of an oval shape, looked like a toy top, somewhat upside down.
It was a bluish yellow or a bluish green color on top.
The bottom was a bright red.
As far as blinking lights, there was no blinking lights on this object at all.
It was one solid light at all times between the two or three different colors.
There was no flashing whatsoever of it.
When Deputy Fitzpatrick and Sergeant Schneider saw this phenomenon,
they made about four pictures with a MNOX camera.
These two pictures came out. They were enlarged by Detective Harold Kerr of the Washtenaw County Sheriff's Department.
These two pictures are from separate negatives.
They both show two light streaks, one here and one here, one here and one here, in the same relative position from which the picture was taken.
These were printed from separate negatives.
The resolution on this picture is a little bit better.

lights along here? This was the housing section of Milan Village. Street lights in the background,
and the railings.
And then you can vaguely see the outline of a clumps of trees
all the way across the picture
and a house at the far left side in both pictures.
These pictures were both taken from the same angle?
Yes.
Detective Kerr, the photo expert who made these enlargements
from the Minox negatives,
tells us that these two markings cannot be flaws in the negative.
He says there were no scratches on the emulsion side of the film.
In addition to that, these prints were made from separate negatives,
and they show these light streaks in the same place in each picture.
Sheriff, what do you think about this now that you've seen these pictures?
Well, I don't know what to think about it.
I was quite skeptical on this until I seen these pictures,
and there definitely is something there, some type of an object.
